entities.name: Sobeslav
entities.description: Assistant to Golgari Guildmaster Jarad vod Savo who was killed by Mazirek in the Undercity.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Ravnican guild allied with the kraul.

entities.name: Mazirek
entities.description: Death priest and leader of the kraul who poisoned Sobeslav and drained his life force.

entities.name: Kraul
entities.description: Insectoid race recently allied with the Golgari.

entities.name: Undercity
entities.description: Ravnica's underground, through which Sobeslav journeyed.

entities.name: Umerilek, the Mausoleum of the Erstwhile
entities.description: Mausoleum filled with ancient undead nobles, opened by Mazirek.

events.summary: Sobeslav leads guards deep into the Undercity to answer Mazirek's invitation.
events.quote: Sobeslav led a contingent of guards on a perilous journey deep into the Undercity

events.summary: In a vast cavern full of kraul, Mazirek reveals he has been poisoning Sobeslav and his guards.
events.quote: Mazirek confronted Sobeslav, who quickly realized the death priest had been poisoning him and his guards

events.summary: The guards collapse and Sobeslav dies in agony as Mazirek drains his life force for a necromantic spell.
events.quote: Sobeslav succumbed last, dying in agony as Mazirek drained his life force to empower his necromantic spell.

events.summary: Mazirek opens a stone slab revealing Umerilek filled with ancient undead nobles who begin to rise.
participants: Umerilek, the Mausoleum of the Erstwhile
events.location: Umerilek, the Mausoleum of the Erstwhile
events.quote: As the mausoleum's inhabitants began to rise, Mazirek stood triumphant

relations.quote: Sobeslav was the assistant to Guildmaster Jarad vod Savo of the Golgari Swarm
dying in agony as Mazirek drained his life force

relations.note: He is the death priest and leader of the kraul.
relations.quote: Mazirek , the death priest and leader of the kraul

relations.note: The kraul were recently allied with the Golgari.
relations.quote: an insectoid race recently allied with the Golgari
